title: openwrt-ubus provider
description: Native ubus-over-HTTP OpenTofu/Terraform provider for OpenWrt. Replaces the net/routers shell/shell_script adapter so OpenWrt devices import to 0-diff.

phases.title: Core (generic, full coverage)
phases.exit_criteria: Builds, vets, tests; covers all uci config + all ubus calls.

phases.title: Validate against live OpenWrt
phases.exit_criteria: house-wap-ax23 sections import to 0-diff through the provider.

items.feature: Provider installable on the Semaphore runner: filesystem_mirror at /var/lib/semaphore/.terraform.d/plugins + scoped .terraformrc; tofu init verified
Live import to 0-diff proven: full 40-section house-wap-ax23 model -> tofu plan = 40 to import, 0 change
Acceptance tests (TF_ACC) against a throwaway OpenWrt

phases.title: net/routers integration
phases.exit_criteria: modules/prosumer/openwrt emits openwrt_uci_section; shell_script retired; house-wap-ax23 + openwrt-lab managed via Semaphore.

items.feature: required_providers + per-device provider for_each (like opnsense); mirror generator emits openwrt
Bridge: system + network bridge-vlans/SVIs + wireless converted to openwrt_uci_section. Remaining shell types: dns/dhcp/firewall/nat/vpn/ipsec/bgp/ddns/logrotate/etc.

house-wap-ax23 imported + adopted via Semaphore (15 sections managed; hostname/timezone applied, defaults preserved). Open: HOME_HOSTS VID 59->58 didn't persist (DSA VID needs delete+recreate; also network-wide); logrotate shell SSH failed; openwrt-lab pending

phases.title: Ergonomics + release
phases.exit_criteria: Optional typed sugar resources; CI; registry publish.

items.feature: uci section ordering support (uci order) for firewall rule precedence
Typed sugar resources (interface, bridge_vlan, firewall_rule, wireless) over the generic core
CI (build/vet/test) + GoReleaser + registry publish + docs gen
